messages:
kai: Heads-up — I'm starting a staged rollout for kernel-quant v3.2. Small canary in us-west-2 (5% of traffic) for 20m. No global drain, just graceful replace on a few pools. Will monitor latency, OOMs, and kv-cache misses.
ash: ack, please pin matmul-legacy on standby for the window (2h) in case we need a quick rollback.
maria: adding short release note and changelog snippet now. tagging @ops-sre for thermal/pressure concerns.
sam: can we enable verbose telemetry for canaries (extra histograms + kv cache hit ratio)? want per-model breakdown.
deploy-bot: PRECHECKS:
```
compat-check: PASS
pack-checksum: PASS
smoke: PASS (staging)
telemetry-hook: ENABLED
rollout_id: r-4523-kq32
```
ops-sre: we saw small CME spikes last night in west; recommend 1 region at a time and lowered concurrency on the canary. Also add a thermal hysteresis cutoff.
kai: good call — reducing canary concurrency to 60% of normal and adding thermal hysteresis: if GPU temp median > 85C for >5m we pause and scale back.
ash: pinned matmul-legacy: pin_id=pin-7721 ttl=2h reason=rollback-hotpath.
release-bot: NOTE: release notes draft created -> https://docs.internal/releases/kernel-quant-3.2 (maria please review)
maria: reviewed and added blurb about "improved int8 matmul kernel selection and kv-cache compatibility fixes". Also included rollback criteria: >10% p50 latency regression or any OOMs in prod canary.
sam: telemetry toggle on canary: added histograms: token-latency-p50/p95, kv-cache-hit, gpu-temp.
deploy-bot: executing rollout step 1 -> canary slice us-west-2 (5%)```
deploy-bot: rollout_event: STARTED region=us-west-2 slice=5% concurrency=60% id=r-4523-kq32-step1
kai: watch logs for the first 5 minutes; if anything looks off ping me directly.
ops-sre: if thermal flaps appear, swap to fallback kernel (v3.1-legacy) via quickpin command and drain new nodes.
nash: quick rollback command (tested):
```
# pin legacy on region and revert routing
cli rollout pin --region us-west-2 --pin-id pin-7721 --duration 2h
cli rollout swap --rollout-id r-4523-kq32 --to-version v3.1-legacy
```
sam: saw a small jitter at t+8m in staging histograms, nothing huge but keeping an eye.
deploy-bot: canary metrics update (t+10m): p50 +2%, p95 +1%, kv-cache-hit stable, OOMs=0, gpu-temp median=78C.
maria: looks within bounds. I'll keep release notes live and paste final blurb once we finish canary.
kai: ok continuing to 15m then evaluate for a gradual 25% slice across us-west regions if stable.
ops-sre: please annotate any thermal anomalies in the incident board.
deploy-bot: UPDATE: canary step complete -> STABLE for step1. Next step scheduled in 10m to increase to 25% across us-west-2 and us-west-1 (staggered).
ash: leaving pin active until rollout completes.
release-bot: publishing interim note to #eng-release-notes: "kernel-quant v3.2 canary started, step1 stable" :memo:
sam: thumbs up, enabling higher-sample telemetry for another 10m.
kai: thanks team — keep comms short in this thread unless urgent. if rollback triggered, we'll annotate with pin id and reason. :thumbsup:
ops-sre: noted. standby for any hotpatch decisions.
